source_context: Clearing bank settlement values: nearest minor unit, exact halfway selects an even number of cents.
Customer credit note on a merchant invoice: nearest cents, tie values go away from zero even for a refund.
Old ledger converter drops every sub-cent fraction toward zero; it never rounds to the next cent.
Bank financial reconciliation with nearest-cent rounding and even-number half-cent tie handling.
Merchant invoice payment amount: nearest cent, exact halves away from zero for debits and credits.
Legacy ledger migration strips fractional cents toward zero instead of rounding.
reason: Use ASCII decimal notation: ≤24 integer digits, ≤12 fractional digits; no grouping, exponent, spaces or currency.
